documents.title: Level 2 duct route
documents.text: For coordination package CP-L2 at Level 2 grid C5, drawing M-201 revision 4 shows a supply duct crossing beam B7 with only 220 mm clearance. What revised duct route should be issued?

documents.title: Duct installation query
documents.text: At Level 2 grid C5 on M-201 revision 4, please clarify the reroute for the supply duct at beam B7; the shown clearance is 220 mm. The response is needed by November 6, 2026 to avoid stopping installation.

documents.title: Level 2 electrical access
documents.text: Also under coordination package CP-L2 at grid C5, the electrical panel needs a maintenance access zone. What access-zone dimensions must be reserved? This requires an electrical answer separate from the duct-routing answer.

documents.text: For service yard wall SY-2, which paint finish is required? No finish selection is recorded.

documents.title: Inspection follow-up
documents.text: Please confirm the reinforcement inspection appointment and written pour release for North Bay N4. This is the same outstanding inspection and release request in the North Bay coordination log; no acceptance or release has been received.

documents.title: South bay inspection
documents.text: For South Bay S4 slab repair, when will reinforcement inspection occur and who will issue the written pour release? This is a different repair location from North Bay N4.

documents.title: Room A12 curing duration
documents.text: What minimum moist-curing duration applies to the Room A12 replacement slab?

documents.title: Room A12 pour release
documents.text: Who has authorized the Room A12 pour to proceed? A curing requirement alone does not establish that the pour has been released.

documents.title: Room A12 repair detail revision 1
documents.text: Room A12 replacement slab: minimum moist curing is 3 days. This revision has been superseded.

documents.title: Room A12 repair detail revision 2
documents.text: Room A12 replacement slab: maintain moist curing for at least 7 days. This requirement does not authorize placement or release any inspection hold point.

documents.title: West gate delivery conflict
documents.text: The approved access plan and the newly issued logistics bulletin give different west gate opening times for November 4, 2026. Which time governs?

documents.title: Approved logistics bulletin
documents.text: The west gate opens for deliveries at 09:00 on November 4, 2026. This bulletin does not state that it supersedes the access plan.

documents.title: Concrete mix substitution
documents.text: May the north stair landing concrete be changed from 30 MPa to 40 MPa based on the supplier email?

documents.title: Supplier email
documents.text: We suggest changing the north stair landing mix from 30 MPa to 40 MPa. Design approval has not been requested.

documents.title: Tank room coordination requests
documents.text: Tank room TR-1 needs three separate answers. First, specify the anchor embedment depth for the pump base. Second, confirm the drain invert elevation at the east wall. Third, assign an owner and due date for providing the inspection certificate. These are distinct requirements in tank room coordination package TR-COORD.
